subject: POC: temporary capacity fuel for Nimbus Retail night soak
messages:
From: Alex Bryant <alex@vantagecloud.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary capacity for Nimbus night soak POC

Hi Vivek / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency numbers. We have a scheduled night soak for the Nimbus Retail POC this Friday (May 7) between 00:00-06:00 PT to validate end-to-end throughput under 400 qps sustained. Our QA lead pushed back: the current trial allocation will fall short once we warm caches and run parallel workloads.

Could Redwood provide a short-term capacity top-up (sandbox fuel) for that window — roughly 100k tokens/day equivalent, or whatever is the closest productized quota you recommend for 6 hours at ~400 qps? We can sign any short addendum required; procurement is on the thread for contracting.

Attached: capacity_request_sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet with expected traffic profile).

Appreciate a quick turnaround; the soak is the gating item for our internal release decision.

Best,
Alex
Alex Bryant
Head of Infrastructure
VantageCloud (on behalf of Nimbus Retail)

> Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency numbers.
> Could Redwood provide a short-term capacity top-up for that window — roughly 100k tokens/day equivalent...?

Alex — thanks for the clear profile. We can support a short-term top-up for the Friday window. Two quick clarifications before I route to approvals:

- Is the 400 qps sustained for the entire 6h window or is it a blended average with spikes?
- Do you need streaming/generation-heavy token budget (chat-style responses) or mostly embeddings/rerank calls?

Ben — can you confirm the standard POC uplift tier and whether we can do this under the existing trial contract vs. a one-off promo credit? If we go one-off, I suggest we propose a capped uplift for the 6h window (so we don't overshoot).

Alex — if you can confirm the traffic profile in the sheet (I skimmed but want to be sure), we'll seek internal signoff today and loop in Procurement for any required paperwork.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Vivek / Marissa — gave this a quick cost/operational pass. Per the traffic profile, a conservative uplift of 120k token-equivalent for the 6h window should be sufficient and keeps cost exposure low. We can implement as a sandbox voucher (promo credit) rather than changing the trial terms.

Operational notes:
- We'll route the credit in the sandbox account tied to the Nimbus POC (deal: DEAL-78431).
- I recommend a hard cap at 150k tokens to prevent runaway usage.
- Please confirm we can schedule the uplift to start 2027-05-07T00:00:00-07:00 and end 2027-05-07T06:00:00-07:00.

Marissa — can you attach the test plan (for our ops runbook) and take point on provisioning?

Karthik — can you check if any infra tuning (batching/kv cache warmup) should be applied for this profile?

Thanks — if procurement needs a one-line amendment we can route DocuSign (link below) for signature.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
